picks.name: The Publican
picks.verdict: The brunch powerhouse. One Off Hospitality's European-inspired beer hall delivers oysters, pork, and what might be the best waffle in Chicago — with honey butter, jam, and maple syrup.
picks.whatToOrder: Order the maple-braised bacon for the table — it's mandatory. The waffle with honey butter is the star. Crab scrambled eggs and chicken schnitzel for savory.

picks.name: Lula Cafe
picks.verdict: Logan Square's farm-to-table pioneer since 1999. Chef Jason Hammel's seasonal brunch helped put the neighborhood on the culinary map — still one of the city's best 25 years later.
picks.whatToOrder: Breakfast burrito is a sleeper hit. Rotating breakfast sandwiches. French toast changes seasonally. Carrot cake for dessert is legendary.

picks.name: Tweet
picks.verdict: Uptown's most beloved brunch spot — and arguably Chicago's most consistent. Free cake when you sit down, the best eggs benedict in the city, and a staff that remembers your name.
picks.whatToOrder: Eggs benedict is the legendary order. The free cake is genuinely excellent. French toast and omelets are rock-solid.

picks.name: Batter & Berries
picks.verdict: The French toast destination. Chef Derek Rylon's four-flavor French Toast Flight is iconic — blueberry, strawberry, caramel, and lemon. Lincoln Park is the original.
picks.whatToOrder: French Toast Flight — four flavors in one order. Waffle flights available too. For savory, the omelets. Lemon French toast is the sleeper best flavor.

picks.name: Big Jones
picks.verdict: Andersonville's Southern fine-dining gem. Chef Paul Fehribach's historically-rooted cooking produces Chicago's best beignets, shrimp and grits, and a legendary Eggs New Orleans with lump blue crab.
picks.whatToOrder: Eggs New Orleans — poached eggs with blue crab cakes in popovers and béarnaise. Beignets to start. Shrimp and grits. Fried green tomatoes to share.

picks.name: m.henry
picks.verdict: Andersonville's daytime brunch temple. Creative riffs on classics — the cinnamon roll French toast is a religion, and Fannie's Killer Fried Egg Sandwich with Gorgonzola on sourdough has a cult following.
picks.whatToOrder: Cinnamon roll French toast. Fannie's Killer Fried Egg Sandwich (eggs, Applewood bacon, Gorgonzola on sourdough). Organic tofu scramble for vegans.

picks.name: Maple & Ash
picks.verdict: Chicago's most over-the-top brunch. Fire-roasted seafood towers, Alaskan king crab benedict, caviar service, and the $200/person IDGAF tasting menu with bottomless champagne.
picks.whatToOrder: IDGAF menu for the full experience. A la carte: Alaskan king crab benedict or fire-roasted seafood tower. Keep the champagne flowing.

picks.name: Superkhana International
picks.verdict: Chicago's most creative brunch. Indian-inspired dishes unlike anything else — uttapam griddle cakes with coconut chutney, French toast with gajar halwa, and a cumin-tequila Bloody Mary.
picks.whatToOrder: Bun omelet sandwich. Uttapam (savory griddle cakes with coconut chutney). French toast with gajar halwa. Cumin-tequila Bloody Mary or ghee-bourbon old fashioned.

picks.name: Obélix
picks.verdict: A Francophile's dream brunch. From Le Bouchon's owners, Obélix does indulgent French bistro — escargots, salade Lyonnaise, and a $145 caviar sandwich.
picks.whatToOrder: Caviar sandwich if budget allows ($145). Otherwise: escargots, croque madame, salade Lyonnaise. Don't leave without a café au lait.

picks.name: Tzuco
picks.verdict: Chef Carlos Gaytán's breathtaking River North restaurant blends French technique with Mexican soul. Belgian waffles with duck leg carnitas — brunch elevated to art.
picks.whatToOrder: Belgian waffles with duck leg carnitas and poached egg. Orange-scented French toast with pink peppercorn crème anglaise. Share the sangria. Tres leches horchata for dessert.

picks.name: Luella's Southern Kitchen
picks.verdict: Chef Darnell Reed's tribute to his great-grandmother Luella. The chicken and waffles are legendary, buttermilk biscuits are perfection, and the Southern comfort vibes are unmatched.
picks.whatToOrder: Chicken and waffles — the must-order. Salmon croquettes. Shrimp and grits. Buttermilk biscuits and skillet cornbread as sides.

picks.name: Dolo Restaurant and Bar
picks.verdict: Chinatown's premier dim sum destination and a completely different brunch experience. Communal dining with egg tarts, pork buns, durian pancakes, and dozens of family-style small plates.
picks.whatToOrder: Egg tarts. Fluffy pork buns. Creamy egg custard cakes. Durian pancakes if you're adventurous. Har gow (shrimp dumplings). Come hungry, bring friends.
